text:
alex: FYI planning to flip the `user_pref_v2` flag tonight during the EU quiet window at 23:00 UTC. Who's owning the push and smoke?

maria: I can own the smoke checks. I'll be online until 00:30 UTC.

sanjay: I can do the deploy if alex is coordinating. PR merged but there's one small review note (non-blocking).

jules: link to PR? want to sanity-check rollout code path.

alex: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4213 - review note is in comments, sanjay already addressed tests.

ops-oncall: I'll be standby for rollback and will have the kill-switch ready. If anything >5% error delta, flip back. :warning:

alex: Smoke checklist (short):
- tenant smoke: sample tenant A+B request flows
- latency: p50/p95 within 10% of baseline
- error rate: <0.5% increase
- end-to-end kv-cache hit sanity

Runbook snippet:
```bash
# toggle via config-api
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN' \ 
  https://config.internal.redwood/v1/flags/user_pref_v2/flip \ 
  -d '{"enabled":true, "percentage":10}'
```

maria: Can you start at 10% for 30m and then 50% for another 30m? That gives me time to run the tenant checks.

jules: +1 to staged increments. Also set default to safe fallback (false) for any unknown tenants.

sanjay: Note: per-tenant batching interacts with this flag for legacy clients. I'll enable a per-tenant opt-out list during the canary, just in case.

alex: Good call. I'll push a config that sets `default=false` and list tenant opt-outs: `legacy_*` pattern.

deploy-bot: Deployment job created #deploy/4213 by sanjay — scheduled for 2026-03-17T23:00:00Z. CI: passed, canary window: 30m.

ops-oncall: Confirming rollback steps: 1) set flag to false via config-api 2) trigger redeploy of routing-proxy if errors persist 3) notify infra oncall for DB stalls.

maria: I'll run tenant A smoke now preflip and post the samples.

maria: Preflip results: tenant A ok, p50 120ms, p95 260ms, errors 0.2%. Tenant B: slightly higher p95 320ms but steady.

alex: thanks. If no objections I'll start the 10% flip at 23:00. sanjay you'll hit the deploy button?

sanjay: Standing by. Will notify here when first batch is live.

deploy-bot: Canary batch (10%) started — 2300Z.

sanjay: Canary live. Monitoring dashboards (links withheld) — initial token drop within expected.

maria: Running tenant flows now. Not seeing regressions.

ops-oncall: No error spike. latency stable.

jules: If everything holds for 30m, agree to move to 50%.

deploy-bot: Canary window complete (30m) — no auto-rollback triggered. Ready for manual increment.

sanjay: Increasing to 50% now.

maria: Post-50% quick smoke: tenant A/B ok, no new errors. p95 increased 5% on tenant B but within the threshold.

alex: great — hold another 30m then full flip if still stable. ops-oncall keep rollback steps handy.

ops-oncall: Roger. If we see error delta >5% or sustained latency >20% of baseline, we'll flip.

jules: Please tag the deployment in the PR with the time window and results.

alex: Will do. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. We'll document the rollout notes in the release board. :thumbsup:
